act.name: Registration of Births and Deaths Act, 1969
act.source_authority: Ministry of Home Affairs, Government of India
act.description: Central law governing registration, certificates, delayed registration and correction of birth and death records.

sections.title: Delayed registration of births and deaths.
sections.text: Section 13 concerns delayed registration of a birth or death after the ordinary reporting period; consult the linked official text for the complete provision.
sections.plain_language_summary: A delayed birth or death registration can be completed using the statutory permission, documents and fee applicable to the delay.
